proposal.reason: Main change is the open-source test workflow system: daily/full case generation moved from committed CSVs to JSON-driven prepare-time generation, execution grouping/rack allocation policy changed (including 8-node support), artifact download integrity checks were added, and full-run performance workbook generation/report publication was introduced in GitHub Actions and xtest runner tooling. Documentation and test updates mostly support this CI behavior change rather than separate module-owned runtime features.
